scenarios.description: Every financial instrument that fulfills the Index Universe Requirements is included in the Index Universe, and nothing else is included.
A financial instrument is included in the Index Universe even though it does not fulfill the Index Universe Requirements.

One financial instrument fulfills the Index Universe Requirements and is included in the Index Universe, while another financial instrument neither fulfills the requirements nor is included; no other instruments are mentioned.
The Index Universe is determined before the Index Universe Requirements are known, and later updated after the requirements are finalized.
